name: work-batch-planner
description: Decide PR grouping, execution topology, and issue order from briefs and host docs. Returns work units for planners. Interactive asks; automatic assumes.

inputs.name: planning-mode
inputs.description: interactive or automatic; controls defaults and questions.

inputs.name: pr-grouping
inputs.description: Optional override per-issue, related, or single.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: work-batch
outputs.description: Grouping, topology, ordered work units, merge order, and rationale.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list when interactive mode needs user input; empty otherwise.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: Labeled defaults and skipped alternatives in automatic mode.
